description: This source file models hardware timers and real-time clock functionalities for a native simulator, including system tick timer, real-time clock, and associated configuration and control functions.

methods.name: hwtimer_set_real_time_mode
methods.description: Sets whether the timer operates in real-time mode or not.

methods.name: hwtimer_enable
methods.description: Enables the hardware timer with a specified period in microseconds.

methods.name: hwtimer_wake_in_time
methods.description: Requests the hardware timer to wake the CPU at a specific future time.

methods.name: hwtimer_set_silent_ticks
methods.description: Sets the number of silent (skipped) timer ticks.

methods.name: hwtimer_get_pending_silent_ticks
methods.description: Returns the number of pending silent ticks.

methods.name: hwtimer_reset_rtc
methods.description: Resets the real-time clock to start from zero.

methods.name: hwtimer_set_rtc_offset
methods.description: Sets an offset in microseconds for the RTC simulated time.

methods.name: hwtimer_set_rt_ratio
methods.description: Sets the ratio of simulated time to real host time.

methods.name: hwtimer_adjust_rtc_offset
methods.description: Adjusts the RTC offset by a delta in microseconds.

methods.name: hwtimer_adjust_rt_ratio
methods.description: Adjusts the ratio of simulated time to real host time by a correction factor.

methods.name: hwtimer_get_simu_rtc_time
methods.description: Returns the current simulated RTC time in microseconds.

methods.name: hwtimer_get_pseudohost_rtc_time
methods.description: Returns a host time that accounts for drift and ratio adjustments, as if the host clock had been running from the simulated clock.
